metadata.name: marco_vault
metadata.description: Marco IPO Subscription Vaults — on-chain vault for HK IPO access via USDC

docs: Marco Pre-IPO Subscription Vaults.
One vault per listing event. USDC is subscribed during a funding
window, deployed to a licensed broker, and — after the shares list
and sell — net proceeds return on-chain for pro-rata redemption.
A single flat protocol fee (default 5%) is taken at settlement.

instructions.name: begin_sourcing
docs: Sealed -> Sourcing. Marks the allocation as requested/pending.

instructions.name: cancel_vault
docs: Abort a pre-deployment vault: * -> Cancelled. Enables refunds and
records disclosed unrefundable costs.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Burn claim tokens, receive pro-rata USDC. Allowed in Claimable/Winding.

instructions.name: conclude
docs: Winding/Claimable -> Concluded. Only after the close-out date. Terminal.

instructions.name: confirm_allocation
docs: Sourcing -> Sourced. Records the confirmed deployable allocation;
the remainder becomes refundable at redemption.

instructions.name: create_share_metadata
docs: Attach Metaplex token metadata to the vault's claim mint so wallets show
a name and symbol. Safe on a mint that already has supply; reads the
vault without writing it. Admin only.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: itself is created and owned by Metaplex during the CPI.

instructions.name: deploy_capital
docs: Sourced -> Deployed (partial deploys allowed). Sends USDC to the
immutable broker destination, capped to the confirmed allocation.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The broker destination — must equal the immutable account fixed at creation.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Subscribe USDC. Partial-fill up to the cap and the per-address
limit; unfilled USDC never leaves the depositor's wallet. Mints
claim tokens 1:1 with accepted USDC.

instructions.name: elect_delivery
docs: While Live and within the election window: pay the protocol fee in
USDC, burn claim tokens, and record a real-share delivery entitlement
for off-chain settlement. Opts these tokens out of cash redemption.

instructions.name: freeze_deposits
docs: Freeze or unfreeze deposits. Admin only.

instructions.name: initialize_vault
docs: Create a vault. PDA seeds: [b"vault", admin, vault_id].
`deposit_destination` (the broker USDC account) is fixed here forever.

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: Claim-token mint, 6 decimals to match USDC. Mint authority is the
vault PDA so only the program can mint/burn. The vault PDA is also
the freeze authority — that is what locks claim tokens in holders'
wallets, and it means no external key can ever freeze or thaw them.

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: The vault's USDC token account (owned by the vault PDA).

accounts.name: deposit_destination
docs: IMMUTABLE broker/SPV USDC account. Only its key is stored; capital
can only ever be deployed here.

instructions.name: mark_listed
docs: Deployed -> Live. Records that the security has listed, the real
share allocation, and opens the share-delivery election window.

instructions.name: mark_realized
docs: Live -> Realized. Records gross sale proceeds (informational).

instructions.name: open_funding
docs: Scheduled -> Funding. Opens the subscription window.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Refund a cancelled vault: burn claim tokens, receive principal less
pro-rata unrefundable costs.

instructions.name: seal_funding
docs: Funding -> Sealed. Closes the subscription window (deadline or manual).

instructions.name: set_fee_timing
docs: Charge the protocol fee at redemption (mint gross) instead of at deposit
(mint net). Admin only, and only before the first deposit.

instructions.name: set_funding_deadline
docs: Extend the subscription window's deadline. Admin only, only while the
vault is still Funding, and only to a future timestamp.

instructions.name: set_transfer_lock
docs: Lock or unlock claim tokens in holders' wallets. Locked by default:
tokens are frozen on mint and can only be burned back to the vault.
Clearing the flag stops new freezes; existing accounts still need
`unlock_shares`. Admin only.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Realized -> Claimable. Records net USDC returned, computes the flat
fee, and sets the redeemable balance. Opens redemption.

instructions.name: sweep_fee
docs: Sweep collected protocol fees to the treasury. Bounded by fees_collected.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc
docs: Must be a USDC account owned by the vault's treasury. `has_one =
treasury` only validates the `treasury` account below — it says
nothing about this token account, so the ownership constraint has to
be stated explicitly or fees could be swept anywhere.

instructions.name: unlock_shares
docs: Thaw one holder's claim-token account once the transfer lock has
been lifted. Permissionless — it only works after admin unlocks.

accounts.name: holder_shares
docs: The holder account to thaw. Constrained to this vault's claim mint,
so the instruction can never touch an unrelated token account.

instructions.name: update_operator
docs: Rotate the operator wallet. Admin only.

instructions.name: wind_down
docs: Claimable -> Winding. Marks the bulk-redeemed residual window.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: vault
docs: The vault this record belongs to.

fields.name: depositor
docs: The depositor wallet.

fields.name: deposit_amount
docs: Cumulative GROSS USDC paid in by this address.

fields.name: shares_minted
docs: Cumulative claim tokens minted to this address. Entry-fee vault: the NET
(`deposit_amount` less the entry fee). Exit-fee vault: equal to
`deposit_amount` (minted 1:1 with the gross; the fee comes off at exit).

fields.name: shares_redeemed
docs: Claim tokens redeemed by this address.

fields.name: usdc_redeemed
docs: USDC received from redemptions.

fields.name: usdc_refunded
docs: USDC received from cancellation refunds.

fields.name: shares_delivered
docs: Claim tokens this address burned to elect share delivery.

fields.name: underlying_delivered
docs: Real underlying shares owed to this address from delivery elections.
Off-chain settlement (broker -> holder brokerage account) reconciles
against this figure.

fields.name: entry_fee_paid
docs: Entry fee this address paid upfront across its deposits. Zero for an
exit-fee vault, where the fee is instead skimmed from the cash
redemption and tracked on the vault's `fees_collected`, not per depositor.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for forward-compatible upgrades.

types.name: ClaimMade
docs: A holder burned claim tokens for their pro-rata USDC.

types.name: DeliveryElected
docs: A holder elected real shares over a cash redemption. The broker delivers
`underlying_shares` off-chain and reconciles against
`buyer_state.underlying_delivered`.

types.name: DepositMade
docs: Events for the four holder-initiated instructions.
These exist for the off-chain orchestrator, which creates every intent from
an observed chain event and never from an HTTP call — the on-chain escrow
*is* the authorisation. Without a structured event the watcher would have to
decode raw instruction data and re-read account state to learn what
happened, which is both fragile and racy.
Admin transitions are deliberately not emitted. The operator submits those
itself, so it already knows they happened; only holder actions arrive
unannounced.
Each event carries `vault_id` alongside the vault pubkey. The orchestrator
keys deals by that string, and including it saves an account read per event
on a hot polling path.
A holder subscribed USDC and received claim tokens.
`accepted` is gross (what the cap counts), `subscribed` is net of the
upfront fee and equals the claim tokens minted. They differ, and conflating
them mis-states the cap.

fields.name: intent
docs: What the depositor asked for, before cap and per-address clamping.

fields.name: accepted
docs: Gross USDC actually pulled from the wallet.

fields.name: fee
docs: Upfront protocol fee taken from the gross.

fields.name: subscribed
docs: Net subscribed — claim tokens minted, 1:1.

fields.name: auto_sealed
docs: True when this deposit hit the cap and auto-sealed the vault.

types.name: RefundMade
docs: A holder burned claim tokens on a cancelled vault for principal less the
pro-rata share of disclosed unrefundable costs.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: admin
docs: Controlling authority — expected to be a Squads multisig PDA.

fields.name: operator
docs: Operator wallet — may trigger capital deployment (can equal admin).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet — receives the protocol fee.

fields.name: deposit_destination
docs: IMMUTABLE broker / SPV USDC account. Deployed capital can only
ever be sent here. Set once at creation, never mutated.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: SPL mint for the vault claim token.

fields.name: vault_usdc
docs: The vault's own USDC token account.

fields.name: vault_id
docs: Human-readable id, e.g. "hkex-sdmc-2026-q3".

fields.name: phase
docs: Current lifecycle phase.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Whether deposits are frozen (emergency control).

fields.name: transfer_lock
docs: Whether claim tokens are locked in holders' wallets. True from
creation: every claim-token account is frozen on mint, so tokens
cannot be transferred or sold on — they can only be burned back
to the vault via claim/refund/elect_delivery. Admin can lift this
with `set_transfer_lock(false)`, after which holders call
`unlock_shares` to thaw their own account.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Maximum USDC the vault will accept (6 decimals).

fields.name: min_deposit
docs: Minimum USDC a single deposit must intend (anti-dust).

fields.name: max_deposit
docs: Maximum cumulative USDC per address (0 = no per-address cap).

fields.name: funding_start
docs: Unix ts the subscription window opens.

fields.name: funding_deadline
docs: Unix ts after which deposits are rejected.

fields.name: close_out_at
docs: Unix ts after which Claimable/Winding can be Concluded.

fields.name: total_deposits
docs: Total USDC subscribed.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Total claim tokens minted (== total_deposits while funding).

fields.name: deployable_amount
docs: Confirmed deployable amount (set at allocation confirmation).

fields.name: undeployed_amount
docs: Subscribed capital NOT deployed (refundable remainder).

fields.name: total_deployed
docs: Total USDC actually sent to the broker destination.

fields.name: shares_allocated
docs: Real underlying shares the broker acquired for the vault, recorded
at listing. Establishes the per-token delivery entitlement:
a claim token converts to `shares_allocated / total_shares` shares.

fields.name: election_deadline
docs: Unix ts the share-delivery election window closes. Elections are
only accepted while Live and before this deadline.

fields.name: delivered_shares
docs: Claim tokens burned via share-delivery election. These leave the
cash cohort, so redemption divides only among the remaining tokens.

fields.name: gross_proceeds
docs: Gross sale proceeds reported at Realized (informational).

fields.name: settlement_amount
docs: Net USDC returned by the broker after the sale.

fields.name: redeemable_amount
docs: USDC available to claimants (settlement balance minus fee).

fields.name: total_redeemed_shares
docs: Claim tokens redeemed so far.

fields.name: total_redeemed_usdc
docs: USDC paid out in redemptions so far.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee in basis points (500 = 5.00%). Marco's single on-chain
take. WHEN it is charged depends on `fee_at_exit`: an entry-fee vault
deducts it from each deposit as it arrives (so claim tokens are the
net); an exit-fee vault mints tokens against the gross deposit and
deducts the fee from the redemption instead. Either way it is the only
fee — no delivery fee, no upside/performance fee.

fields.name: fees_escrowed
docs: Fee deducted from deposits but not yet earned. Held in the vault and
refunded with principal if the deal is cancelled before deployment —
the fee is only earned once capital actually deploys into the deal.

fields.name: fees_collected
docs: Fee earned, moved across from `fees_escrowed` when capital deploys.
Excluded from the redeemable pool and sweepable to the treasury.

fields.name: fees_swept
docs: Protocol fee swept to treasury.

fields.name: unrefundable_costs
docs: Disclosed unrefundable costs deducted from refunds on cancel.

fields.name: total_refunded_usdc
docs: USDC returned to depositors during a cancellation refund.

fields.name: fee_at_exit
docs: Fee timing. `false` (the original behaviour, and the default for every
account created before this field existed — it reads as a zeroed
reserved byte) charges the fee at deposit: tokens are minted net.
`true` charges it at redemption: deposits mint 1:1 against the gross,
and `claim` deducts the fee from the payout. Fixed by `set_fee_timing`
before the first deposit and never changed after.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved for forward-compatible upgrades.

types.name: VaultParams
docs: All vault parameters, frozen at creation. Grouped into one struct so
the entrypoint stays readable and the client passes a single object.

fields.name: max_deposit
docs: 0 = no per-address maximum.

types.name: VaultPhase
docs: The Marco vault lifecycle. Each phase gates a specific set of
actions; transitions are driven by admin calls backed by real
off-chain events (allocation confirmations, listing, sale, cash
return). Naming is Marco's own — the shape follows the economics
of a subscription vault, not any one competitor's labels.
